source: Benchmark scope matters. A microbenchmark that measures one ZXNAME0000XZ kernel is not directly comparable to tokens/s for a serving system. An achieved TFLOP/s number for one dtype is not comparable to another dtype’s peak. A vendor’s sparse peak is not the same as dense peak.
zh: 基准范围很重要。测量一个 ZXNAME0000XZ 内核的微基准不能直接与服务系统的令牌进行比较。一种数据类型所达到的 TFLOP/s 数无法与另一种数据类型的峰值相比较。供应商的稀疏峰值与密集峰值不同。
